name: Welfare
overview: Scripture teaches that God's people are called to care for the poor and vulnerable within their community by intentionally leaving portions of their harvest for them and not hardening their hearts toward those in need. Giving to the poor is promised to bring blessing, while neglect brings curses, emphasizing the importance of generosity as a reflection of obedience to God. Believers are also reminded to support the weak through their labor and to follow the example of Christ, who taught that it is more blessed to give than to receive. Ultimately, God's plans for His people include peace and hope, which are connected to living faithfully in community and caring for others.
